content:
Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. But they are at the whim of volatile macroeconomic factors that influence capital spending (like interest rates), and the market seems convinced that demand will slow. Due to this bearish outlook, the industry has tumbled by 3% over the past six months. This performance is a stark contrast from the S&P 500's 12.3% gain.

Only some companies are subject to these dynamics, however, and a handful of high-quality businesses can deliver earnings growth in any environment. With that said, here are three industrials stocks we think can generate sustainable market-beating returns.

Backed by two million square feet of lab testing space, AAON (NASDAQ:AAON) makes heating, ventilation, and air conditioning equipment for different types of buildings.

Demand is greater than supply as the company's 93.5% average backlog growth over the past two years shows it's securing new contracts and accumulating more orders than it can fulfill

Market share will likely rise over the next 12 months as its expected revenue growth of 26.5% is robust

Industry-leading 17.4% return on capital demonstrates management's skill in finding high-return investments

AAON's stock price of $76.33 implies a valuation ratio of 28.6x forward P/E. Is now a good time to buy? See for yourself in our full research report, it's free .

Founded in 1967, Fastenal (NASDAQ:FAST) provides industrial and construction supplies, including fasteners, tools, safety products, and many other product categories to businesses globally.

Offerings are difficult to replicate at scale and result in a best-in-class gross margin of 45.4%

Excellent operating margin of 20.4% highlights the efficiency of its business model

Free cash flow margin increased by 5.1 percentage points over the last five years, giving the company more capital to invest or return to shareholders

Fastenal is trading at $49.85 per share, or 38.2x forward P/E. Is now the time to initiate a position? Find out in our full research report, it's free .

Founded in 1987, American Superconductor (NASDAQ:AMSC) has shifted from superconductor research to developing power systems, adapting to changing energy grid needs and naval technology requirements.

Annual revenue growth of 43.6% over the past two years was outstanding, reflecting market share gains this cycle

Free cash flow margin increased by 25.5 percentage points over the last five years, giving the company more capital to invest or return to shareholders

Improving returns on capital suggest its past investments are beginning to deliver value

At $28.65 per share, American Superconductor trades at 29.1x forward P/E. Is now the right time to buy? See for yourself in our in-depth research report, it's free .

chineseTitle: 3只适合长期投资者的工业股票
chineseSummary: 即使工业企业大多不被注意，它们也是我们国家的支柱。但它们受到影响资本支出（如利率）的宏观经济因素的影响，而且市场似乎确信需求将会放缓。由于这种悲观的前景，该行业在过去六个月内下跌了 3%。这一表现与标普500指数12.3%的涨幅形成鲜明对比。
chineseContent:
即使工业企业大多不被注意，它们也是我们国家的支柱。但它们受到影响资本支出（如利率）的宏观经济因素的影响，而且市场似乎确信需求将会放缓。由于这种悲观的前景，该行业在过去六个月内下跌了 3%。这一表现与标普500指数12.3%的涨幅形成鲜明对比。

然而，只有一些公司会受到这些动态的影响，并且少数高质量的企业可以在任何环境下实现盈利增长。话虽如此，我们认为以下三只工业股票可以产生可持续的跑赢市场的回报。

AAON（纳斯达克股票代码：AAON）拥有 200 万平方英尺的实验室测试空间，为不同类型的建筑生产供暖、通风和空调设备。

需求大于供应，过去两年该公司积压订单平均增长 93.5%，这表明该公司正在获得新合同，积累的订单数量超出了其所能满足的数量

由于预计收入增长 26.5% 强劲，未来 12 个月市场份额可能会上升

行业领先的 17.4% 资本回报率展现了管理层寻找高回报投资的技巧

AAON 的股价为 76.33 美元，意味着估值率为 28.6 倍的远期市盈率。现在是购买的好时机吗？请亲自查看我们的完整研究报告，它是免费的。

Fastenal（纳斯达克股票代码：FAST）成立于 1967 年，为全球企业提供工业和建筑用品，包括紧固件、工具、安全产品和许多其他产品类别。

产品难以大规模复制，毛利率达到同类最佳 45.4%

20.4% 的出色营业利润凸显其商业模式的效率

过去五年自由现金流利润率增加了5.1个百分点，为公司提供了更多资本用于投资或回报股东

Fastenal 的交易价格为每股 49.85 美元，即预期市盈率 38.2 倍。现在是建仓的时候吗？请在我们的完整研究报告中找到答案，它是免费的。

美国超导公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMSC）成立于 1987 年，已从超导研究转向开发电力系统，以适应不断变化的电网需求和海军技术要求。

过去两年年收入增长43.6%，表现出色，反映了本周期市场份额的增长

过去五年自由现金流利润率增加了25.5个百分点，为公司提供了更多资本用于投资或回报股东

资本回报率的提高表明其过去的投资已开始创造价值
